exposure: Pharmacist-led intervention program (sending monthly reports on prescribing data and drug review results based on DRG data)
cohort: Patients from the OB25 (caesarean section without comorbidities or complications) Diagnosis-Related Group (DRG) at a tertiary teaching hospital in China.
finding: Interventions based on DRG data, specifically a pharmacist-led program sending monthly reports, were highly efficient and feasible for reducing inpatient pharmacy costs and inappropriate/non-essential drug use.
followup_time: Approximately 1 year after intervention implementation (from 2019 to 2020)
